backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the GenMitra print platform backend, defining data types (Product, Template, Order, Cart, User) and implementing authentication, user profiles, product/template/order/cart management, and admin seeding using stable maps and access control mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two high-confidence features: adding `https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz` to all origin whitelists/CSP tags, and fixing TanStack Router route definitions that have both `id` and `path` set simultaneously in `App.tsx`.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and recent changes, serving as a reference for build planning and code review across hooks, components, and pages.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes, covering colors, borders, charts, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the GenMitra Print Platform that sets up the React root div, loads the main script, and includes a Content-Security-Policy meta tag explicitly allowing framing from `https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz` and related caffeine domains.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app entry that configures TanStack Router with all public and admin routes, fixes the router crash by using only `id` (no `path`) on the pathless layout route, and wraps the app in QueryClient, ThemeProvider, and Toaster providers.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Protects admin routes by redirecting unauthenticated users to the login page, showing a loading spinner while the session is being checked.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Provides the admin panel shell with a collapsible sidebar navigation, logo, nav links, and a logout button.
Paginated customer reviews section displaying six hardcoded testimonials in a three-column grid with avatar initials, star ratings, and previous/next navigation controls.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Renders an accordion-style FAQ section with six hardcoded questions and answers about the photo gift service, toggling open/closed state per item.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Displays a grid of featured or category-filtered products fetched from the backend (falling back to demo data), with loading skeletons and navigation to individual product pages.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand info, contact details, social media icons, and navigation links for Store, Company, and Support sections.
frontend/src/components/FrameStyleDropdo: A custom dropdown component for selecting a photo frame style, displaying thumbnail images and names for five predefined frame options.
frontend/src/components/HeroBanner.tsx: Renders the homepage hero section with a background image, headline, CTA buttons for shopping and browsing categories, and key stats badges.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Provides the main app shell with a sticky header (logo, category dropdown, cart icon, auth controls), a promo bar, mobile menu, and a footer wrapping the routed page content.
frontend/src/components/OffersBanner.tsx: Displays a promotional banner offering 20% off the first order with a 'Shop Now' button that navigates to the home page.
frontend/src/components/ProductCategoryG: Renders a list of product categories (Photo Prints, Frames, Magnets, Mugs, Corporate Gifts) with icons that navigate to the filtered home page on click.
frontend/src/components/ShopFramesBySize: Displays a grid of photo frame sizes with images and labels, each navigating to the Photo Frames category on click.
frontend/src/components/TrustFeatures.ts: Shows four trust-building feature cards (rating, delivery, quality guarantee, support) under a 'The GenMitra Promise' heading.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an Internet Computer actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminSession.ts: Manages admin session state via sessionStorage with hardcoded credentials, exposing login, logout, and session status helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Wraps Internet Identity authentication and user profile fetching into a unified auth hook with login, logout, and profile state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including products, templates, cart, orders, and user profile CRUD operations using TanStack Query's useQuery and useMutation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, configures Tailwind CSS, and defines CSS custom properties for a light/dark design system including colors, spacing, and reusable component utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/demoProducts.ts: Exports a static array of demo ProductInfo objects across categories (prints, frames, magnets, mugs, etc.) with placeholder image paths and product metadata for use without a live backend.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with TanStack QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Admin dashboard displaying summary stats (orders, earnings, users, products) and a table of the five most recent orders with status badges.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettingsPa: Admin page for managing delivery pincodes, allowing admins to add or remove 6-digit pincodes via form inputs with toast notifications for feedback.
frontend/src/pages/admin/CustomerManagem: Admin page that lists all customers with expandable rows showing each customer's order history fetched on demand.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin page for viewing, filtering, and managing all customer orders, with support for status updates, custom image downloads, and production file generation.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ProductManageme: Admin page for creating, editing, and deleting products, including image compression on upload and management of size options and categories via a modal form.
frontend/src/pages/admin/TemplateManagem: Admin page for managing photo templates with CRUD operations, image/preview upload with compression, and fields for photo slots and DPI settings.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Multi-step checkout page component handling cart review, shipping address entry, payment method selection, and order confirmation with success state display.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page that collects shipping address and payment method (COD, UPI, Card, Netbanking), validates inputs, and submits an order via React Query mutations with a mock payment modal for non-COD methods.
frontend/src/pages/CreateAccountPage.tsx: Account creation page that collects username and optional email, triggers Internet Identity login, and saves the user profile to the backend canister.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Canvas-based photo frame editor page allowing users to upload, zoom, rotate, drag, and add text overlays to an image, then add the customized product to the cart.
frontend/src/pages/ForgotPasswordPage.ts: Forgot password page that accepts an email address and simulates sending a reset link, then shows a confirmation message.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page that renders a hero banner, category grid, featured products, and FAQ sections, or displays a filtered product grid when a category query param is active.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page supporting both Internet Identity-based user login and a username/password admin login flow, with redirect handling after successful authentication.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Displays a list of the current user's orders with status icons and color badges, allowing navigation to individual order detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Shows a post-purchase confirmation screen with order details (ID, total, payment, delivery estimate) fetched via order tracking, and navigation buttons to orders list or home.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Renders a detailed view of a single order including a status timeline, item list, shipping address, and payment info fetched by order ID.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Shows a product's images, description, size options, pincode delivery check, and an 'Add to Cart' button that navigates to the product editor.
frontend/src/utils/imageHelpers.ts: Utility function that normalizes image source values by detecting data URIs, HTTP URLs, relative paths, or raw base64 strings and returning a safe, correctly formatted src string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, colors (using CSS variables and oklch), shadows, border radii, font sizes, and animations for the frontend UI.
project_state.json: Project state snapshot (version 59) describing the full-stack online printing platform's architecture, tech stack, known issues, and existing features for build planning and issue tracking.
